body: Central credit runs need the WinB proxy idle for the WHOLE run (Fable2 #7811, from src/engram_turn_checks.rs:947-1020, 1052-1059; open bug w-f5f89e7eed42, raised to P0 on 2026-11-25). A LOCAL remote-proxy session record (Central session table, remote_id set; e.g. WinB runner session-13475, or a Mac proxy) that is in a turn (active, approval or stopping) counts as an UNRESOLVED-workdir writer of EVERY Central worktree. Any overlap with a Central registered check withholds its credit: the writer starting a turn, or reporting a command or edit, while the check is open. DL560 C6/C7/s4 are federation/relay sessions, not local proxy records, and do NOT count. Scheduler practice: before each credit-needing Central run (registered cold runs, Engram FULLs, Windows focused registered checks), let WinB finish its current job, then HOLD WinB idle (no new GO, no turns) until that run's END. Run the credit runs back-to-back to minimise WinB idle time, and let WinB work in between. Seen 2026-11-25: Merger w-8f12 FULL test-ab36871a was uncredited because session-13475 was in a turn at launch. Retire this memory when w-f5f89e7eed42 lands.
